sentences.text: Today we will talk about Lebanon.
Lebanon is a small, historic, and beautiful country in the Middle East.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Lebanon?
Lebanon is in Western Asia, on the eastern coast of the Mediterranean Sea.
It is next to Syria and Israel.
It has mountains, beaches, and green valleys.
What is the capital city of Lebanon?
The capital city is Beirut.
Beirut is a lively and colorful city by the sea.
It has markets, cafes, historic sites, and modern buildings.
Other cities include Tripoli, in the north, Sidon, and Tyre, ancient cities by the coast.
Bioblos, one of the oldest cities in the world.
Zala, in the mountains.
How many people live in Lebanon?
About six million people live in Lebanon.
There are also many refugees from other countries.
Lebanon has people of different religions, cultures, and backgrounds.
What language do people speak in Lebanon?
The official language is Arabic.
Many people also speak French and English.
Some speak Armenian and other local languages.
In daily life, people often mix Arabic, French, and English in one conversation.
What is the weather like in Lebanon?
Lebanon has a Mediterranean climate.
Hot, dry summers, cool, rainy winters.
In the mountains, there is snow and winter.
People can swim in the sea and ski in the mountains on the same day.
What does Lebanon look like?
Lebanon has the Mediterranean Sea on the west.
Two mountain ranges with forests and snow.
The Baker Valley, a rich farming area.
Old ruins, villages, and modern cities.
The cedar tree found in the mountains is a national symbol.
What animals live in Lebanon?
In Lebanon, you may find foxes, wild cats, and hyenas, owls, eagles, and songbirds, sheep, goats, and cows on farms, fish and crabs in the sea.
Cedar forests are home to many birds and insects.
What do people eat in Lebanon?
Lebanese food is fresh, colorful, and healthy.

People eat bread like pita or flatbread, rice, chickpeas, and lentils, olives, tomatoes, and cucumbers, meat, chicken, and fish, popular dishes, hummus, chickpea spread, tabbouleh, parsley and bulgur salad, falafel, fried chickpea balls, kibbutt meat with bulgur, baked or fried, manakish, flatbread with thyme or cheese, baklava, sweet pastry with nuts and syrup.
Food is often shared with family and friends at big tables.
What do people drink in Lebanon?
People drink water.
Strong Arabic coffee served in small cups, tea with mint or sugar, fruit juices, like orange or pomegranate.
Adults may drink Iraq, a traditional Annie's flavored drink.
Hospitality is important.
Guests are always offered food or drink.
What is life like in Lebanon?
Life in Lebanon is busy, warm, and full of family life.
People enjoy eating together, talking at cafes, dancing at weddings, going to the beach or mountains, listening to Arabic music.
Despite challenges, people stay strong and hopeful.
What are some holidays and traditions in Lebanon?
Lebanon has many religions, so people celebrate different holidays.
Eid al -Fitr and Eid al -Adha for Muslims, Christmas and Easter for Christians, Independence Day, November 22nd, New Year's Eve with music and fireworks.
There are also weddings, name days and village festivals.
Some fun facts about Lebanon by blows in Lebanon is one of the oldest cities in the world.
The alphabet started in ancient Phoenicia, now part of Lebanon.
The Lebanese flag has a cedar tree in the middle.
Lebanon is famous for its poets, singers and writers.
You can ski and swim on the same day.
Now you know many things about Lebanon.
You know where it is, what people speak and what they eat.
You learned about the land, history and culture.
Well done.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emili.
